# mezmo_http_client_source (Resource)

Collect data by periodically polling an HTTP endpoint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    mezmo = {
      source = "registry.terraform.io/mezmo/mezmo"
    }
  }
  required_version = ">= 1.1.0"
}

provider "mezmo" {
  auth_key = "my secret"
}

resource "mezmo_pipeline" "pipeline1" {
  title = "My pipeline"
}

resource "mezmo_http_client_source" "source1" {
  pipeline_id          = mezmo_pipeline.pipeline1.id
  title                = "My HTTP client source"
  description          = "This polls an HTTP endpoint for data"
  endpoint             = "https://example.com/data"
  method               = "GET"
  scrape_interval_secs = 30
  scrape_timeout_secs  = 10
  decoding             = "json"

  auth = {
    strategy = "bearer"
    token    = "my-secret-token"
  }

  headers = {
    "X-Custom-Header" = "custom-value"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint` (String) The URL to poll for data. Must be a valid URI.
- `method` (String) The HTTP request method to use when polling the endpoint.
- `pipeline_id` (String) The uuid of the pipeline

### Optional

- `auth` (Attributes) Configures HTTP authentication. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auth))
- `decoding` (String) Configures how events are decoded from raw bytes.
- `description` (String) A user-defined value describing the source component
- `headers` (Map of String) A key/value object describing a header name and its value.
- `scrape_interval_secs` (Number) The interval between polling requests, in seconds.
- `scrape_timeout_secs` (Number) The timeout for each polling request, in seconds.
- `title` (String) A user-defined title for the source component

### Read-Only

- `generation_id` (Number) An internal field used for component versioning
- `id` (String) The uuid of the source component

<a id="nestedatt--auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auth`

Optional:

- `password` (String, Sensitive) The basic authentication password.
- `strategy` (String) The authentication strategy to use.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The bearer token.
- `user` (String) The basic authentication user.
